title: potentilla cinerea subsp. velutina
intro: Potentilla cinerea subsp. velutina, commonly known as Velvet Cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species within the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Velvet Cinquefoil include reducing inflammation, soothing skin irritations, and exhibiting potential antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
